## Change

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

Describe relevant checks.

## Release notes

- [ ] Add user-visible changes to root `CHANGELOG.md` using [the required format](../docs/changelog-format.md), or explain why this PR needs no user-facing notes.
- [ ] For a release PR, the exact upcoming release version has a nonempty entry. The release workflow rejects missing or malformed notes.
